items: Root node: tree ka sab se pehla ya sab se oopar wala node, jaise computer ka main folder jis ke andar baqi saare folders aur files hote hain.

Edges aur nodes: tree ke alag alag elements nodes hain, aur unhein jorne wali lines edges kehlati hain. Jis node ka koi child node na ho use leaf (patta) kehte hain, jaise folder mein rakhi file jis ke andar aur kuch nahi.
Height (unchai): root node se sab se door leaf tak ka sab se lamba raasta tree ki height hai. Yeh batati hai ke tree kitna gehra ya uncha hai.
Balanced trees: jab baen aur daen shaakhon ki height taqreeban barabar ho to tree balanced kehlata hai. Tafseel section 4.1.7 mein hai.

blocks.text: Neeche Python classes se family tree banane ki saada misal hai. Is mein family members (nodes) banaye jate hain aur un ke children (aulad) jore jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein chhapa hua code nahi chalta (pehli ghalti par hi SyntaxError). Is mein: Fami1yMember (1 ke saath), _ _init_ _ (space ke saath), ek line par do statements, FamilyTre e, naamon ke beech spaces (an c e s t o r _ n am e, ctii 1 d_name), parent_name ke baad ) ghayab, current.member (sahi current_member), ghalat indentation, # ki jagah •, tirchhe quotes ’, aur Parenti/Childl (sahi Parent1/Child1). Upar sahi code hai, jo Python 3.13 mein chala kar check kiya gaya.

items: FamilyMember class ek shakhs ko dikhati hai. Har shakhs ka naam (name) aur bachchon ki list (children) hoti hai.
FamilyTree class poore tree ko sambhalti hai, jo root par buzurg (ancestor) se shuru hota hai. Is mein bachche jorne (add_child) aur kisi fard ko dhoondne (_find_member) ke functions hain.
add_child pehle _find_member se walid (parent) dhoondta hai, phir us ki children list mein naya FamilyMember jor deta hai.
_find_member root se shuru kar ke har node dekhta hai; naam mil jaye to wohi node lauta deta hai, warna har bachche ke andar dobara (recursion se) dhoondta hai, aur kahin na mile to None lautata hai.

blocks.text: Code chalne ke baad yeh tree banta hai: Grandparent ke do bachche Parent1 aur Parent2, aur Parent1 ke do bachche Child1 aur Child2. Figure 4.6 mein har node ek daira (circle) hai aur teer walid se aulad ki taraf hain.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure dairon ka khandani tree: oopar Grandparent se Parent2 aur Parent1 ki taraf teer; Parent1 se Child2 aur Child1 ki taraf teer.
